ITEM 1 | Flat rectangular wedge with golden-brown crisp pastry edges and a pale yellow-white melted topping with orange-red streaks, sitting at upper left of plate, approx 9 cm long by 5 cm wide, about 2 cm thick | 110
ITEM 2 | Pale green crisp lettuce leaves with lighter ribs and some creamy pale dressing coating, piled loosely in upper center, spanning about 12 cm by 8 cm, leafy and airy with moderate height | 90
ITEM 3 | Dark green and purple-tinged mixed salad leaves with thin red onion slivers, a cherry tomato piece, and a few dark olive-like pieces, spread along left-center edge, about 10 cm by 7 cm, low and loose | 45
ITEM 4 | Sliced meat with a medium-rare pink-red interior and browned, slightly crusted exterior coated with flecks of seasoning, fanned slices about 8 cm by 4 cm, about 1 cm thick, moist with light juiciness | 85
ITEM 5 | Roasted potato pieces with golden-brown crisp edges and pale fluffy interiors, some glazed with brown bits, several chunks about 3 to 4 cm each, roughly 2 to 3 cm tall, sitting center right | 150
ITEM 6 | Mashed or pureed pale yellow-cream starchy mound with slightly grainy, soft, crumbly texture, spread along right-lower edge, about 8 cm by 5 cm, about 1.5 cm high | 80
ITEM 7 | Small brown crumbs and specks scattered on the plate surface near the top and right edge, dry and loose | 3
